contracts_rationale: Packaging-configuration bug fix: no API, CLI surface or payload is added or changed.
friendly_name: Anchor the sdist README include to the repository root
purpose_context: The published source archive picks up every README.md in the repository because its include rule is unanchored, so documentation and mission folders leak into the archive. This mission anchors the rule to the repository root, keeps a future site folder out, and pins the result with a test on the built archive before the docsite migration adds more README files.
purpose_tldr: Stop the source distribution shipping hundreds of nested README files from docs and mission folders.
source_description: Issue #6926: anchor the sdist README.md/CHANGELOG.md include to the repository root and exclude site/** (ADR 2026-10-31-1 D-12).
